description: CTAG, PSA and Vigo City Council provide test-session data from automated drop-off and pickup requests at Praza do Rei parking in Vigo. A mobile application requests parking and collection, with the test ending after the vehicle parks at the pickup area and the application informs the user. The enclosed site has no GPS coverage, so the scenario uses a LiDAR indoor-positioning system. The generic stream descriptions also list GPS positioning, creating a component-level limitation: actual presence of GPS values cannot be inferred from that template. Described contents include vehicle state, dynamics, driver interactions, environment detections and vehicle/server IoT communications. The related urban-driving deposit covers a different proving-ground experiment. Neither deposit establishes a publicly available parking-control implementation or a measured citywide service outcome. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
